Based on the January 8, 2026 V2 rulebook. Local event rules may vary.

Match rules

Drive with WASD or the arrow keys. Use Space near an object to pick it up. Drive inside Blue Base and release to score. You can carry one object at a time.

  • Exploration banks 100 per cube removed from the Trident and 200 per cube left in base at the phase boundary.
  • At the finish, cubes in base earn 100 each and the Ocean Core earns 300.
  • The short- and long-hook cubes hang beneath the long central beam. Hang your robot on your alliance’s colored crossbar with H. Wait until Occupation or until all Trident objects are removed. Each hang earns 700 and a double hang adds 300.
  • A fall earns the other alliance 50. A Reset Card gives the other alliance another 50 and can only be used during Scramble.

All-bot mode runs both alliances through the entire match. The model uses approximate robot geometry, collisions, pickup and hanging. The score shows banked points plus projected finish points during play.
